tasks.title: Implement Interactive Temple Map Foundation
tasks.summary: Create the foundation for the Interactive Temple Map for the web application.
acceptanceCriteria: A new page `app/(public)/map/page.tsx` is created and renders a 'Temple Map' header.
A basic test in `tests/unit/map.test.tsx` passes when running `npm run test`.

tasks.title: Add Points of Interest to Temple Map
tasks.summary: Add Points of Interest support to the Interactive Temple Map for the web application to fulfill the next milestone in the v2.0 Experience roadmap.
acceptanceCriteria: A component is implemented to visualize points of interest on the interactive map page.
Example points of interest data structure is established and rendered correctly.
Unit tests run successfully via `npm run test`.
outOfScope: Live dynamic point of interest location tracking

tasks.title: Add Accessibility Info to Temple Map
tasks.summary: Add accessibility information (e.g., wheelchair access, special facilities) to the Temple Explorer to fulfill the next milestone in the v2.0 Experience roadmap.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend the temple area types to include accessibility properties (e.g. wheelchair access, ramps).
Update the example points of interest data to include realistic accessibility data.
Render the accessibility information visually on the interactive map/temple explorer components.
Unit tests run successfully via `npm run test`.
outOfScope: Dynamic live availability of accessible facilities
